results.title: Dance with the Jackals 8
results.overview: Having overcome various dangers together for years, the Jackals gang are trying to establish a new life when they are mysteriously kidnapped and find themselves on their way to Germany, right in the middle of a human trafficking network. In this absurd journey, orchestrated by Şerafettin Top Müller, the Jackals must confront their past grievances and survive within an international criminal organization they unknowingly became involved in.

results.title: Changing Landscapes
results.overview: Returning home after 19 years away, Michael revisits familiar places he frequented with his late partner, Anna.

results.title: Joonè Delam
results.overview: In a bid for closure a first-generation Iranian-Australian woman is compelled to confront her abusive father on his deathbed.

results.title: American Baby
results.overview: A Filipino immigrant and her charismatic American husband, a casket salesman, share a life shaped by sacrifice and silence, as their child revisits the fragile promise of the American Dream inside the quiet fractures of their marriage.

results.title: Remember
results.overview: An estranged couple who have forgotten what it means to love each other find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading.

results.title: Djinn Wedding
results.overview: When four estranged siblings reunite in their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, long-buried memories begin to resurface. As the celebrations unfold, two of them are drawn back into the unbreakable bond they once shared. Family secrets slowly come to light, leading them on a journey through grief and the invisible ties between generations.

results.title: Glass Saints
results.overview: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

results.title: Two Cigarettes, Three Nights
results.overview: Kanna is an illustrator living in Kyoto. Three nights with Haseo, a "guy friend" she reunites with after seven years, change the course of her life.

results.title: Rusalki
results.overview: A girl wakes up by a lake with a collection of women and no memory of how she got there. As fragments from her past resurface and memories come flooding back, tensions rise between the women and the girl tries to find a way to escape…

results.title: Most Likely
results.overview: As the night progresses, his crush Gregory seems to be getting closer to him...

results.title: Waiting
results.overview: Nicolas has come a long way to find Sofiane again. But the meeting, which seemed like it would be simple, doesn’t go as planned. Nicolas moves through this drawn-out day, caught between what was promised and what is still to come.

results.title: Molder Man
results.overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

results.title: The Easy Way Out
results.overview: Ted returns to his hometown to find his big brother Jim at the end of his rope. But is it too late to save him?

results.title: Façade
results.overview: In an apartment building, a variety of residents live side by side. Behind each door lies a personal secret. Some darker, some stranger than they first appear. Outwardly cheerful Joosep, dreamy Pille-Riin, withdrawn Ott, and nosy Magda – each harbors an inner world that slowly begins to seep through the wallpaper and walls. As the residents struggle to keep their secrets hidden, cracks begin to spread through the building’s facade. Soon, all their secrets threaten to come to light.

results.title: Smooth Summer
results.overview: As Hanna and her ten-year-old niece, Erle, get ready for a day at the beach, Hanna is faced with a dilemma: How can she manage to be both a cool aunt and a good role model in this situation?

results.title: Tony Spiteri
results.overview: A one-on-one game of basketball becomes a fragile confrontation between two men struggling to process loss.
